title: Burgee registries
description: Canonical enumerations for the Burgee wire format. Markdown tables in this directory are rendered from this file by tools/render_registries.py. A value is never reused once assigned. Changes by BEP only.

values.name: IDENTITY
values.meaning: Who the node is and what it can do. Required at Level 0 and above.

values.name: LOCATION
values.meaning: WGS84 or local-frame position. Optional; indoor nodes omit it.

values.name: SAFETY
values.meaning: Authority command. Sent only by marks or authority nodes.

values.name: INTENT
values.meaning: Next three relative waypoints and ETA. Reserved for v0.2.

values.name: ground_robot
values.meaning: Wheeled or tracked mobile robot not covered by a more specific class.

values.name: sidewalk_delivery
values.meaning: Sidewalk or campus delivery robot operating in public space.

values.name: legged
values.meaning: Quadruped or other legged robot.

values.name: humanoid
values.meaning: Bipedal humanoid.

values.name: mark_gate
values.meaning: Fixed node controlling a gate, door or barrier.

values.name: charger
values.meaning: Fixed node offering a charging connector.

values.name: lift
values.meaning: Fixed node representing a lift or lift lobby.

values.name: vehicle
values.meaning: Road or yard vehicle, driven or autonomous.

values.name: cart_tug
values.meaning: Cart, tug or AMR carrying a load in an industrial setting.

values.name: handheld
values.meaning: Carried by a person: a phone, wearable or mobility-aid attachment. Hails and reads; never advertises.

values.name: other
values.meaning: No listed class applies. The card says more.

values.name: can_yield
values.meaning: Can stop or pull aside on request.

values.name: can_stop
values.meaning: Can come to a full stop within 1 s of a verified STOP.

values.name: can_wait
values.meaning: Can hold at a named point for a bounded time.

values.name: carries_payload
values.meaning: Currently carrying a payload.

values.name: requests_passage
values.meaning: Will hail marks with access/1 requests.

values.name: provides_passage
values.meaning: Is a mark that grants passage.

values.name: provides_charge
values.meaning: Is a mark that offers charging.

values.name: needs_charge
values.meaning: Battery below the operator's threshold; will seek a charger.

values.name: human_escort
values.meaning: A person is aboard or is being escorted.

values.name: priority_emergency
values.meaning: Claims priority class 2. Valid only with a registry countersignature.

values.name: priority_authority
values.meaning: Claims priority class 3. Valid only with a registry countersignature.

values.name: negotiates
values.meaning: Conformance Level 2 or above: accepts proposals, not only declines.

values.name: is_mark
values.meaning: Fixed node.

values.name: announces_intent
values.meaning: Answers person/1 request_intent with its side of passing and ETA (the accessibility announcement).

values.name: reserved_14
values.meaning: Reserved. Transmit 0, ignore on receipt.

values.name: reserved_15
values.meaning: Reserved. Transmit 0, ignore on receipt.

values.name: idle
values.meaning: Powered, stationary, no task.

values.name: transiting
values.meaning: Moving on a task.

values.name: waiting
values.meaning: Stationary on a task, holding for a condition or another node.

values.name: docked
values.meaning: At a charger or dock.

values.name: emergency_stop
values.meaning: Stopped by a safety trigger; will not move until cleared.

values.name: degraded
values.meaning: Operating with a known fault; expect reduced capability.

values.name: servicing
values.meaning: Mark only: currently serving another node.

values.name: standard
values.meaning: Default.

values.name: service
values.meaning: Maintenance, cleaning, or scheduled service in progress.

values.name: emergency
values.meaning: Medical, fire or security response. Requires countersignature.

values.name: authority
values.meaning: Site operator or public authority. Requires countersignature.

profiles.field: beacon byte 19 bit index; card burgee.profiles[] as id/version

values.name: rightofway
values.meaning: Who yields at a pinch point.

values.name: access
values.meaning: A mobile node asks a mark for passage or service.

values.name: charge
values.meaning: Negotiating a charging session.

values.name: handoff
values.meaning: Transferring a payload between two nodes.

values.name: safety
values.meaning: Verified authority commands in full.

values.name: person
values.meaning: A handheld speaks for a person: request_intent, request_yield, request_contact.

safety_commands.field: SAFETY beacon byte 1; SAFETY_STOP message command

values.name: clear
values.meaning: Previous command lifted; resume normal operation.

values.name: hold
values.meaning: Stop and remain in place until clear.

values.name: stop
values.meaning: Stop immediately. The only command honored from an unverified beacon.

values.name: evacuate_corridor
values.meaning: Leave the named zone by the nearest exit; do not enter it.

values.name: busy
values.meaning: Encounter limit reached; retry after the stated backoff.

values.name: no_profile
values.meaning: The requested profile or action is not supported.

values.name: policy
values.meaning: The operator's or mark's policy forbids it.

values.name: unsafe
values.meaning: The local planner judges the proposal unsafe.

values.name: low_battery
values.meaning: Insufficient energy to comply.

values.name: payload_locked
values.meaning: Payload state prevents the action.

values.name: timeout
values.meaning: The counterpart did not answer in time.

values.name: unverified
values.meaning: Card or token failed verification.

values.name: priority_lower
values.meaning: The requester's priority class is lower than required.

values.name: other
values.meaning: No listed reason applies; a text field may say more.

values.name: started
values.meaning: The agreed action has begun.

values.name: waiting
values.meaning: Holding for a condition named in the task.

values.name: done
values.meaning: The agreed action is complete.

values.name: failed
values.meaning: The agreed action could not be completed; a reason code follows.

values.name: stopping
values.meaning: Level 1 fallback: the node is coming to a stop and will hold.

values.name: continuing_slow
values.meaning: Level 1 fallback: the node is continuing on its path at reduced speed.

values.name: HAIL
values.meaning: Initiator opens the encounter: ephemeral ID, card digest, requested profile, nonce.

values.name: HAIL_ACK
values.meaning: Responder answers: card digest, both nonces signed.

values.name: CARD_REQUEST
values.meaning: Ask for the full card when the digest is not cached.

values.name: CARD
values.meaning: The signed card, chunked.

values.name: PROPOSE
values.meaning: One proposal under a profile; creates an A2A task.

values.name: ACCEPT
values.meaning: Commits to the proposal.

values.name: COUNTER
values.meaning: Alternative proposal; the original is cancelled.

values.name: DECLINE
values.meaning: Declines with a reason code.

values.name: STATUS
values.meaning: Progress on an agreed task.

values.name: ABORT
values.meaning: Cancels an agreed task.

values.name: SAFETY_STOP
values.meaning: Authority command with full token; highest priority.

values.name: BYE
values.meaning: Closes the encounter. Carries no A2A payload.
